title: Umprofethi Wezintaba Eziqoshiwe
intro: Ezihlane zase-Arabia lasendulo ezilukhuni, kwavela umuntu phakathi kwabantu abadumile ngobuciko babo obungavamile. Imizi yabo yavela edwaleni eliqinile, kodwa izinhliziyo zabo zazilukhuni kunezintaba ababeziqophile. Isithunywa saphezulu safika nesibonakaliso esisodwa esimangalisayo - kodwa ukuqhosha nokungalaleli kwaholela emiphumeleni esheshayo neyesabekayo. Ungayibona yini inceku ehloniphekile abantu bayo abakhethe ukubhujiswa kunesiqondiso?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesixwayiso kubantu bakithi, ngibabizela ekukhulekeleni uNkulunkulu oyedwa.
Abantu bakithi babehlala phakathi kwezakhiwo zamadwala ezinkulu, beqopha izindlu ezinhle kakhulu ezintabeni.
Ikamela lensikazi eliyisimangaliso laphuma edwaleni eliqinile ngesikhathi ngithandaza, uphawu olucacile oluvela kuSomandla.
Ngitshele abantu bakithi ukuthi babelane ngamanzi naleli kamela lensikazi futhi bangalilimazi.
Abantu bami baceba ikamela eliyinsikazi, balinquma imisipha, bazibophelela ekubhujisweni kwabo.
Ukuzamazama komhlaba okwesabekayo kwashaya abantu bami, bashiywa bewile benganyakazi emakhaya abo.
arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
